runtime.execution: Current Reborn workspace: canonical sealed loop families/stages, durable turn/process coordination, native/WASM hook middleware and per-user Docker command substrate.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns turn/process journals and sandbox lifecycle; host ports consume model/filesystem/DB services. Per-user sandbox is governed by harness, unlike Arconaut consumer-only shared compute.

summary: Strong typed lifecycle and projection boundaries, bounded native/WASM hooks and atomic swaps of individual provider wrappers; current composition disables model subagent spawning despite implementation/tests.

inspection.scope: Traced current workspace rather than removed src monolith: planner/stages, prompt middleware production wiring, process cancellation/supervisor, shell/sandbox, compaction artifacts/effectiveness, provider reload and subagent deny filter.
inspection.limits: No acquired code run. Every domain/extension, full original transcript storage, hook install entry point and crash recovery not exhaustively audited. Self-authored hook types not credited as exposed model operation; production caller not found in scope.

actions.name: builtin.shell / scoped output
actions.output: exit/status/rendered output and readable saved-output path
actions.lifecycle: new shell action in persistent workspace; hard120s; async owned sandbox task
actions.authority: Ask manifest plus runtime policy/scoped mounts/credential binding

actions.name: Hook before_prompt / before_capability observers
actions.output: additive prompt patches, gate decision and event metadata
actions.lifecycle: bounded extension calls around compiled loop; not whole-turn replace
actions.authority: trust-tier/host-granted hook sink, model self-authorship caller not found

actions.name: Compaction task / projection summary
actions.input: safe completed message range and trigger
actions.lifecycle: separate range artifact selected into projection, bounded ineffective automatic attempts

actions.name: Provider reload
actions.output: candidate chain swap or typed error
actions.lifecycle: per-call provider snapshot; newly-added cheap slot restart-required

actions.name: Process cancel / supervisor shutdown
actions.output: cancel wake or awaited supervisor closure
actions.lifecycle: cancel request cooperative; Drop request differs from awaited shutdown; external effects separate

actions.name: spawn_subagent (disabled by default)
actions.lifecycle: implemented dependent-run machinery; default policy removes model surface

filesystem.detail: Compiled coding manifests and scoped saved-output publication; individual file operations not exhaustively traced.

processes.detail: Native shell with per-user sandbox task/container ownership; normal output publish and resource ceiling.

code_actions.detail: Shell executes ordinary programs and WASM extension hook bodies; no model persistent interpreter kernel established.

persistent_kernel.detail: Persistent filesystem workspace, but shell process state explicitly does not persist; no shared Python namespace path established.

standing_database.detail: Not established beyond inspected current Reborn loop, process, hook, shell, compaction and model reload paths.

workflow_programming.detail: Native sealed stage/family composition plus bounded additive/gate hooks; arbitrary model/operator turn program replacement unavailable in inspected API.

multi_model.detail: Primary/cheap provider chains configurable and hot swapped; simultaneous child override policy not established.

live_collaboration.detail: Child lifecycle/result vocabulary exists, model spawning default-denied; no unrestricted live peer room proved.

concurrent_work.detail: Leased supervisor task pool and independently owned sandbox execution tasks; model children default disabled.

steering_interrupt.detail: Cooperative token + wake and leased execution fencing; outer command await can detach owned execution, not quiescence.

turn_redefinition.detail: Default planner slots sealed, hooks additive/policy/observer; full executable turn cannot be hot replaced through traced surface.

compaction.detail: Validated range summary artifacts and rebuilt-prompt effectiveness circuit; retain projection separation rather than mutate core stage.

context_repair.detail: Range-addressed separate summary artifacts support replacing selection while retaining reference to source span; arbitrary model repair operation/source retention storage not fully traced.

original_audit.detail: Typed sanitized runtime events and saved command outputs are useful, but event schema deliberately excludes raw provider/program payload.

audit_query.detail: Durable scoped event/result references are query primitives; model full-original audit query API not established.

hot_change.detail: Actual candidate provider-chain replacement; each in-flight request retains its wrapper snapshot, but primary and cheap wrappers swap separately rather than as one atomic generation. An initially absent cheap wrapper cannot newly activate without restart.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Durable process/turn vocabulary supports recovery, but no compiled refit/outpost transfer and external-effect settlement barrier established.

remote_services.detail: Provider/host-scoped filesystem/process ports and credentialed sandbox consumers; harness still owns per-user container lifecycle.

self_improvement.detail: Self-authored hook contract is restrictive/run-scoped and source caller only found in tests during inspection; cannot credit as model-governed autoresearch.

complaints.detail: Not established beyond inspected current Reborn loop, process, hook, shell, compaction and model reload paths.

authority.detail: Shell Ask default, hard120s/resource bounds, scoped credentials and disabled spawn; authority vocabulary a substantial mismatch with unrestricted operator brief.

evaluation.detail: Direct rebuilt-prompt compaction oracle; child scripted e2e is ignored by default and must be explicitly enabled, not normal capability evidence.

time_order.detail: Host runtime stamps UTC loop start, Instant-backed latency and task heartbeat/deadline vocabulary; not logical paused-time/refit contract.

evidence.claim: Legacy monolith deleted; current root package only integration tests.
Default strategy composition sealed/crate-private, not operator/model mutable slots.
Actual compiled stage objects and order vocabulary.
Prompt patches additive snippets/metadata only; cannot replace messages or identity.
Actual before-prompt dispatch called by middleware.
Production wraps prompt port with instruction materialization and refreshed bundle authority.
Self-authorship contract only restriction and current run; durable surface future, no exposed model caller established.
Installed WASM hook resolution and bounded sink vocabulary, not arbitrary hot core replacement.
Cooperative cancellation atomic flag and wake token, not resource termination.
Leased task heartbeat fencing stops local execution on lease loss; does not confirm every external effect settled.
Explicit shutdown awaits supervisor; Drop only requests it.
Shell actual native dispatch, Ask default and hard120s maximum.
Saved output published through scoped filesystem before rendered JSON result.
Actual first-party shell/file/skill/trigger manifests registered before policy filters.
Persistent per-user workspace guidance explicitly says shell process state does not persist between calls.
Per-user lifecycle gate, credential guard and container ensure performed by harness.
Command wrapped in spawned owned task; dropping outer await does not itself abort task.
Validate range, build input, model summary, sanitize and persist artifact.
Separate range-addressed summary artifact with replace-when-selected cumulative-barrier policy.
Effectiveness judged after rebuilt prompt including summary; third ineffective automatic compact trips run circuit.
Runtime event schema carries redacted safe metadata/byte counts and bounded closed labels, not original IO.
Reload builds candidate then swaps primary/cheap wrappers; adding absent cheap wrapper needs restart.
Each model call snapshots current provider wrapper; in-flight call retains prior object.
Operator live reload resolves file/provider stored key then invokes actual handle.
Composition global deny removes spawn_subagent model surface; explicit config override can re-enable.
Default disabled IDs includes spawn_subagent.
Child run/thread identity and CancelRequested distinct from Cancelled in event vocabulary.
Ignored test proves parked parent/child result in scripted model when explicitly enabled, not default availability.
Direct prompt-stage oracle counts ineffective rebuilt prompts and fourth automatic compact suppression.

tests.oracle: Exactly third ineffective compact opens circuit and fourth automatic attempt suppressed; mocked prompts, not summary fidelity; not run.
Scripted provider park/resume with child result; explicitly ignored while spawn default disabled; not run.

strengths: Typed durable identity/status and honest request-vs-terminal distinctions.
Separate summary artifacts and actual rebuilt-prompt compaction usefulness test.
Production hook materialization and bundle-authority reissue wired rather than just interface declarations.
limits: Model subagent capability denied by current default composition; README/test presence cannot imply availability.
Loop strategy slots sealed and hook mutations additive.
Sandbox owned task survives cancellation of outer await; complete settlement needs additional state.
Runtime events sanitized metadata, not raw original audit.
Provider snapshots are atomic per wrapper; primary/cheap replacements are separate, with no shared-generation activation barrier.
arconaut_questions: Adopt lifecycle distinctions conceptually while allowing model ordinary program changes.
Test hot activation across whole turn/workflow boundary, not only provider object swap.
Separate durable internal fencing from confirmed foreign program/provider settlement.
